sa: राम उवाच ममापराधात् तैः क्षुदैर्हतस्त्वं तात बालिशैः। कार्तवीर्यस्य दायादैर्वने मृग इवेषुभिः॥
en: Rama said: O father, for my fault you have been killed like a deer in the forest with arrows by those mean and foolish wretches, the sons of Kirtavirya.

sa: शल्य उवाच अथ तामब्रवीद् दृष्ट्वा नहुषो देवराट् तदा। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामहमिन्द्रः शुचिस्मिते॥
en: Shalya said Then did Nahusha, the king of the gods, seeing her address her thus-“I am the Indra of the three worlds, O you of sweet smiles." me as

sa: मातुर्हि वचनं श्रुत्वा तदा सलिलकर्मणि। कर्णस्य क्रियतां तोयमिति तप्यामि तेन वै॥
en: At the time of celebrating the water rites (after the battle), I heard my mother say, Do you offer oblations of water to Karna! I am burning with grief.

sa: तदापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य मुष्टिनाभिजघान ह। मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतं तच्छैलाग्रं व्यशीर्यत।। सविस्फुलिङ्गं सज्वालं निपपात महीतले॥
en: Seeing it descend, he dealt it a blow; and struck by the blow, the mountain-top was shattered in pieces; and dropped to the earth glowing and shooting living flames.

sa: योऽरिणा सह संधाय शयीत कृतकृत्यवत्। स वृक्षागे यथा सुप्तः पतितः प्रतिबुध्यते॥
en: Is like a person who awakes after having failen down from the top of a tree where he slept. Counsel should be kept concealed without the fear of calumny.

sa: कथमग्निर्न ने धक्ष्येत् कथमाखु नाशयेत्। कथं न स्यात् पिता मोघः कथं माता ध्रियेत नः॥
en: We do not know how we may escape from the fire, or from the mouse. We do not see how our father's act of procreation may not be in vain and how our mother may be saved.

sa: न पूर्वे नापरे चकुरिदं केचन मानवाः। इतीदं चुकुशुर्देवाः कृते कर्मणि दुष्करे॥
en: After the accomplishment by him of this feat, the very gods had exclaim saying, We do not see in the three worlds with all their mobile and immobile creations,

sa: कर्णः शोकसमाविष्टो महोरग इव श्वसन्। स शैनेयं रणे क्रुद्धः प्रदहन्निव चक्षुषा॥
en: And heaving sighs like a mighty serpent smitten with grief and darting wrathful glance upon the grandson of Sini as if to consume him (therewith) in that encounter, Karna.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तापस्ये मे मनस्तात वर्तते कुरुनन्दन। उचितं च कुलेऽस्माकमरण्यगमनं प्रभो॥
en: Dhritarashtra said-Odelighter of the Kurus, my mind is fixed, O son, on penances. O powerful one, it is proper for our family that I should retire into the forest.

sa: वायु रुवाच किंचिद् धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि मानुषाणां सुखावहम्। सरहस्याश्च ये दोषास्ताशृणुध्वं समाहिताः॥
en: Vayu said I shall recite some duties the observance of which produces happiness to mankind. Do you listen also with rapt attention, to certain transgressions upon which they depend.

sa: तुष्टासि यदि मे देवि वरमेतं वृणोम्यहम्। संतानं परमो धर्म इत्याहुर्मां द्विजातयः॥
en: O goddess, if you are pleased with me, then I pray for this boon. The Brahmanas have told me that one attains to the crowning merit by having children.

sa: अत्र कृष्णो हरिश्चैव कस्मिंश्चित् कारणान्तरे॥ स्थितौ धर्मोत्तरौ होतो तथा तपसि धिष्ठितौ।
en: In this spot Krishna and Hari lived formerly. The other two, however, viz., Nara and Narayana, are now living here performing penances for the object of increasing their merit.

sa: तादृशं भुवि नो युद्धं दिवि वा श्रुतमित्युत। उपारमत तत् सैन्यं सरथाश्वनरद्विपम्॥
en: Was such a battle seen or heard in heaven or on earth as took place (between Karna and Satyaki.) The entire army consisting of cars, horses, men and elephants.

sa: मम रामः सखा वत्से प्रीतियुक्तः सुहृच्च मे। जमदग्निसुतो वीरः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥
en: Rama is my friend, child, and he is my well-wisher and is highly pleased with me that hero, the son Jamadagni and the foremost of all wielders of weapons.

sa: द्यूते दुरात्मभिः क्लिष्टा: कृष्णया तारिता वयम्। जयद्रथेन च पुनर्वनाच्चापि हृता बलात्॥
en: When the wicked-souled (sons of Dhritarashtra) gave us pain at the game of dice we were delivered by Krishna. (But) Jayadratha forcibly carried her off even from the forest.

sa: तं भीमसेनः समरे विव्याध नवभिः शरैः। शकुनि च चतुःषष्ट्या पार्श्वस्थांश्च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Bhimasena, in that battle, struck Uluka with many keen arrows and Shakuni with four and sixty and each of the other warriors who fought around them with three arrows.

sa: ते च दृष्ट्वा तदा सुप्ते उभे देव्यौ च तं नृपम्। सुप्तमेवोद्गतप्राणमन्तःपुरममन्यत॥
en: Finding these two ladies asleep and the king seeming as if sleeping, the inmates of the inner apartment showed themselves as if their lives had departed out of them.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच ज्येष्ठानज्येष्ठतां तेषां नामानि च पृथक् पृथक्। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणामानुपूर्व्यात् प्रकीर्तय॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Lord, tell me the names of all the sons of Dhritarashtra beginning from the eldest, according to the order of their births. Vaishampayana said :

sa: प्रजह्यात् समरे प्राणांस्तस्माद् विन्दामि कश्मलम्। तस्य त्वं पदवीं गच्छ गच्छेयुस्त्वादृशा यथा॥
en: He may lose his life. For this reason it is that I am so cheerless. Therefore do you follow in his track, even as men like you should do.

sa: कैकेय्या यानि चोक्तानि वाक्यानि वदतां वर। तव प्रव्राजनार्थानि स्थितानि हृदये मम॥
en: O you the foremost of those skilled in speech, I have still in my mind the words which were uttered by Kaikeyi for sending you away to the woods.

sa: श्वोभूतेऽथ ततः साम्बो मुसलं तदसूत वै॥ येन वृष्ण्यन्धककुले पुरुषा भस्मसात् कृताः।
en: When the next day came, Shamba actually produced an iron bolt through which all the individuals in the family of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas became reduced to ashes.

sa: अहमप्यनुरूपस्ते वयस्यो ज्ञास्यसे शनैः। न तु वक्तुं समर्थोऽहं त्वयि आत्मगतान् गुणान्॥
en: You also shall by and by learn that I am a fit friend for you; but I can not speak to you of the qualities that abide in me.

sa: हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य रत्नानां चान्ववेक्षणे। दक्षिणानां च वै दाने कृपं राजा न्ययोजयत्॥
en: The king (Yudhishthira) appointed Kripa to look after the diamonds, the gold the pearls and the gems, and he was also appointed to distribute Dakshina (gift) to the Brahmanas.

sa: एवं गते वै यद् भावि तद् भविष्यति संजय। क्षत्रधर्मः किल रणे तनुत्यागो हि पूजितः॥
en: Such being the case, O Sanjaya, what will happen must happen (in spite of all that I can do to prevent it). Besides it is the honored duty of a Kshatriya to quit this life in battle."

sa: भीष्मस्य समरे राजन् मृत्योर्हतुं महात्मनः। विदर्शयन् बलं शूरः शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Who had been, Oking, the cause of death of the illustrious Bhima. Then the heroic Kritavarman displaying his prowess fell upon Sikhandin like a tiger falling upon an elephant.

sa: अरक्षितात्मा यो राजा प्रजाश्चापि न रक्षति। प्रजाश्च तस्य क्षीयन्ते ततः सोऽनुविनश्यति॥
en: If the king does not take steps for his own safety and does not protect his subjects, the latter first meet with destruction which ultimately overtakes the king himself.

sa: ततो मां भगवानाह वितरिष्यामि ते द्विज। सरस्वतीह वाग्भूता शरीरं ते प्रवेक्ष्यति॥
en: The holy one, thus solicited, told ine,-I shall grant you the Yajushes. Made up of the essence of speech, the goddess of learning Sarasvati will enter into your person.

sa: एतत् फलमसूयाया अभिमानस्य वा विभो। तस्माद् बुध्यस्व मान्धातर्मा त्वां जह्यात् प्रतापिनी॥
en: This, O powerful one, is the outcome of malice and pride. Be you awakened, O Mandhatri, so that the goddess of prosperity ! may not in anger desert you.

sa: असमञ्जो गृहीत्वा तु क्रीडतः पथि दारकान्। सरय्वां प्रक्षिपन्नप्सु रमते तेन दुर्मतिः॥
en: Asamañja by way of sport catching people on the way, used to throw them into the waters of the Sarayū, and that wicked-minded wretch made merry over the same.

sa: शङ्खानां तुमुलः शब्दः श्रूयते लोमहर्षणः॥ आनकानां च राधेय मृदङ्गानां च सर्वशः।
en: There is being heard the hair-stirring and loud sound of the conch. The sound of drums and cymbals, O son of Radha, is being also heard on all sides.

sa: अद्भुतस्य तु माहात्म्यं यथा वेदेषु कीर्तितम्॥ तादृशं विद्धि सर्वेषामेको ह्येषु हुताशनः।
en: Know that the prowess of all fires is the same as that of the Adbhuta fire as described in the Vedas. All these fires are one and the same.

sa: शक्र उवाच यत् तद् यानसहस्रेण ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः। लोकान् प्रतापयन् सर्वान् यास्यस्मानवितर्कयन्॥
en: Shakra said Formerly, attended by a train consisting of thousands of vehicles and kinsmen, you used to march, burning all the worlds with your splendour and disregarding us all.

sa: दुर्गे विनाशिते कर्म भवेत् सुखपरिश्रमम्। अल्पयत्नेन कार्येऽस्मिन् मम स्यात् सफलः श्रमः॥
en: On the fortifications being destroyed, my work shall nave its toils crowned with joy. By undergoing slight labour in this business, I shall have my pains furnished with fruit.

sa: हत्वा जित्वा च मघवन् यः कश्चित् पुरुषायते। अकर्ता होव भवति कर्ता ह्येव करोति तत्॥
en: O Maghavat, that person, who having killed or defeated any one brags of his manliness, should know that he is not the actor, but that the act has been performed by another who is the real agent.

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नस्तु यद् युद्धमर्जुनस्य च संजय। अन्येषां च महीपानां पाण्डवैस्तद् ब्रवीहि मे॥
en: Moreover describe to me, O Sanjaya, how that battle of Arjuna took place with Ashvatthaman; and also that of other supporters of the earth with the sons of Pritha.

sa: सत्यवादी शमपरस्तपस्वी दग्धकिल्बिषः। समुत्पन्नः स तु महान् सह पित्रा ततो गतः॥
en: He is truthful, free from passions and a great ascetic who has destroyed all his sins; he went away with his great father as soon as he was born.

sa: नोच्छ्रितं सहते कश्चित् प्रक्रिया वैरकारिका॥ शुचेरपि हि युक्तस्य दोष एव निपात्यते।
en: Enemies desirous of a quarrel cannot bear the elevation of an enemy engendered by his great deeds. Faults are attributed to even a person soul performing penances. of pure

sa: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो लभते धनम्। सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत पादमप्यस्य यः पठेत् ॥
en: Reading even a single verse of this poem, one who has no son, obtain him; one having not riches, gets by them, and people are freed from all sins.

sa: व्यपेते तु जीवे निकुम्भस्य हृष्टा विनेदुः प्लवंगा दिश: सस्वनुश्च । बलं राक्षसानां भयं चाविवेश॥
en: Nikumbha being deprived of his life, the monkeys began to shout-as if resounding all the quarters. And with it the whole earth moved and the abode of the celestials dropped down. And the Rākşasas-hosts were greatly terrified.

sa: द्वितीयं च तृतीयं च चतुर्थं पञ्चम तथा। आत्तमात्तं महाराज भीमस्य धनुराच्छिनत्॥ तव पुत्रो महाराज जितकाशी मदोत्कटः। स तथा भिद्यमानेषु कार्मुकेषु पुनः पुनः॥
en: Similarly, O mighty monarch, he cut-off the second, the third, the fourth and the fifty bows taken up by Bhima. And O great king, your son, desirous of success and swelling with pride, cut-off another bow as soon as it was taken up by Bhima. His bows being thus again and again cut-off (by Duryodhana) he i.e. Bhima.

sa: यदा भवति निर्द्वन्द्वो मुनिर्मौनं समास्थितः। अथ लोकमिमं जित्वा लोकं विजयते परम्॥
en: The Muni who sits in Yoga mediation and who becomes indifferent to happiness and misery, honour and insult, conquers this world and conquering it, he conquers the highest world.

sa: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा तं विप्रं देववर्णिनम्। यज्ञाय वरयामास संतानार्थं कुलस्य च।२।।
en: Then bowing down the head before the Vipra effulgent like a celestial, he appointed him to undertake the ceremony, for the purpose of obtaining offspring to perpetuate his line.

sa: मृदुं लोकहिते युक्तं दान्तं करुणवेदिनम्। निर्वीर्य इति मन्यन्ते नूनं मां त्रिदशेश्वराः।५५।।
en: Truly shall the celestials regard me as one devoid of prowess, who am mild-tempered, kind, ever engaged in the welfare of the humanity, and have controlled all my senses.

sa: स तु तान् वशगान् कृत्वा जित्वा चेमां वसुन्धराम्। ईजे यज्ञशतैरिष्टैर्यथाशास्त्रं तथाऽनध॥
en: Thus having brought them under his control and having conquered this world, he celebrated a hundred desirable sacrifices, in accordance with the ordinances of the Shastras, O sinless one.

sa: नागः शत्रुजयो नाम मातुलोयं ददौ मम। तं ते निष्कसहस्रेण ददामि द्विजपुङ्गव॥
en: I offer you, o great ascetic, with a thousand gold coins, this excellent elephant, called the destroyer of foes, which had been bestowed upon me by my maternal uncle.

sa: कपिलायां तु दत्तायां यत् फलं ज्येष्ठपुष्करे। तत् फलं भरतश्रेष्ठ विप्राणां पादधावने॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the merit equal to that of giving away a Kapila cow in Pushkara (Tirtha) is obtained by washing the feet of the Brahmanas.

sa: राक्षसं जानमानोऽपि यो हन्यानरकं व्रजेत्। अपक्वस्य च कालेन वधस्तव न विद्यते॥
en: He who kills such a one even knowing him to be a Rakshasa goes to hell. Besides you cannot be killed before the (fixed) time (for your death) comes.

sa: तैर्थिकं भुञ्जते यस्तु मणिनागस्य भारत्। दष्टस्याशीविषेणापि न तस्य क्रमते विषम्॥ तत्रोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
en: O descendant of Bharata, he who eats anything belonging to that Tirtha does not die even if he is bitten by a venomous snake. Living there for one night, the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: हृतस्वस्य हि यद् दुःखं हतपुत्रस्य चैव यत्। ऋणिनः प्रति यच्चैव स्वार्थाद् भ्रष्टस्य चैव यत्॥ स्त्रियाः पत्या विहीनाया राज्ञा ग्रस्तस्य चैव यत्। अपुत्रायाश्च यद् दुःखं व्याघ्राघातस्य चैव यत्॥ अध्यूढायाश्च यद् दुःखं साक्षिभिर्विहतस्य च। एतानि वै समान्याहुर्दुःखानि त्रिदिवेश्वराः॥
en: The grief of one who has lost all his wealth, of one who has lost a son, of one who is in debt, of one who is separated from his companions, of a woman who has lost her husband, of one who has lost all in consequence of the king's demand, of a woman who is sterile, of one who is being devoured by a tiger, of one who is a co-wife, and of one who has been deprived of his property by false witnesses, is said by the celestial to be uniform in degree.

sa: नैव स्म प्रतिजानाति ब्रह्मवध्यां स्वयंकृताम्। मम भ्रात्रा कृतमिदं मया स परिमोक्षितः॥
en: He did not also admit, that he had observed the vow for his own sake. (He said), “My brother did it and I have freed him from that sin."

sa: न प्रवक्ष्यामि परुषं भ्रातृनन्यांश्च पार्थिवान्। स्थितो निदेशे ज्ञातीनां योक्ष्ये तत् समुदाहरन्॥
en: I shall not speak a harsh word to my brothers or to any of the kings of the earth. I shall remain obedient to my relatives and practice virtue.

sa: ये चास्य सचिवा मन्दाः कर्णसौबलकादयः। ते तस्य भूयसो दोषान् वर्धयन्ति विचेतसः॥
en: Those wretches also, who his counsellors, namely, Karna, the son of Subala (Shakuni) and others, always encourage him in his course of vice; he is incapable of understanding things.

sa: कीर्तिता द्रौपदी वाचा अनुज्ञाता च पाण्डवैः। भवत्यविजिता केन हेतुनैषा मता तव॥
en: Draupadi was mentioned (by Shakuni) in conversation, and she was approved of as a stake by the Pandava, why is it (then) your opinion that she is not won?

sa: स तथा प्रवदन् क्रोधात् तैश्च प्रेष्यैः प्रभाषितः। तूष्णीं जगाम ब्रह्मर्षिर्वनमेव महातपाः॥
en: Having said this in anger and having been reprimanded by the king's men, that Brahmana Rishi, that great ascetic, became silent; and he then went away to the forest.

sa: अहं सार्थस्य नेता वै सार्थवाहः शुचिस्मिते। मनुष्यं नलनामानं न पश्यामि यशस्विनि॥
en: O you of pure smiles, I am a merchant and the guide of this caravan. O renowned lady, I have not seen any man bearing the name of Nala.

sa: स तु तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा सैनिकान् युद्धदुर्मदान्। प्रेषयामास कौरव्य उत्सारयत तानिति॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, hearing their words, he (Duryodhana) sent a number of his soldiers, to all difficult to be vanquished in battle, commanding them drive away the Gandharvas.

sa: रवेस्तमिस्रागमनिर्गमांस्ते तथोदयं चास्तमनं च वीराः। समावृताः प्रेक्ष्य तमोनुदस्य गभस्तिजालैः प्रदिशो दिशश्च॥
en: Having witnessed the setting in and exit of darkness, the rising and the setting of the sun and all the cardinal points covered with his (sun's rays), those heroes,

sa: दृष्ट्वा विचित्राणि गिरौ वनानि किरीटिनं चिन्तयतामभीक्ष्णम्। बभूव रात्रिदिवसश्च तेषां संवत्सरेणैव समानरूपः॥
en: Inspite of beholding many romantic forests on the mountain, as they could not help constantly thinking of Arjuna, every day and night appeared to them (long) as a year.

sa: आहूतो हि परै राजा क्षात्रं व्रतमनुस्मरन्। दीव्यते परकामेन तन्नः कीर्तिकरं महत्॥
en: Having been summoned by the Kurus and having remembered the Kshatriyas Dharma (usage), the king played at dice against his will. This is certainly conductive to one's great fame.

sa: शिविरुवाच नैवाहमेतद् यशसे ददानि न चार्थहेतोर्न च भोगतृष्णया। पापैरनासेवित एष मार्ग इत्येवमेतत् सकलं करोमि॥
en: Shibi said: It was not for fame or for wealth or from desire of acquiring any object of enjoyment that I did all this. This path is (never) sinful; it is for this I do all this,

sa: प्रातिकाम्युवाच यदा नाभूत् कैतवमन्यदस्य तदादेवीत् पाण्डवोऽजातशत्रुः। न्यस्ताः पूर्वं भ्रातरस्तेन राज्ञा स्वयं चात्मा त्वमथो राजपुत्रि॥
en: Pratikamin said When he had nothing else to stake, it was then that Ajatasatru (Yudhisthira), the son of Pandu, staked you. The king had first staked his brothers, then himself, and then, O princess, he staked you.

sa: सर्प उवाच आहारो राजपुत्रोऽयं मया प्राप्तो मुखागतः। गम्यतां नेह स्थातव्यं श्वो भवानपि मे भवेत्॥
en: The snake replied Having come to my mouth, I have got this son of a king for my food. Do leave this place. You ought not to remain here. For, (if do) I will eat you tomorrow.

sa: यस्य चार्थार्थमेवार्थः स च नार्थस्य कोविदः। रक्षेत भृतकोऽरण्ये यथा गास्तादृगेव सः॥
en: He who considers that his wealth exists for himself alone does not at all understand the purpose of wealth. He is like the servant tending kine in the forest.

sa: वयसा तुल्यतां प्राप्ता सखी तव भवत्वियम्। एतया सह मोदस्व निरुद्विग्नमनाः सदा॥
en: As she is of the same age with yourself, do you take the lady as your companion and also play with her always without any apprehension in the mind.'

sa: मयाभिपन्नः पूर्वं हि राक्षसोऽयमिहागतः। कामात् परिभवाद् वापि न मे जीवन् विमोक्ष्यसे।२०॥
en: This Rakshasas either listlessly or with the intention of killing me came here and he was first aimed by me, therefore you cannot escape from me with your life.

sa: ततोऽस्य सर्वाननुगान् हनिष्ये दुर्योधनं चापि कुरुश्च सर्वान्। आत्तायुधं मामिह रौहिणेय पश्यन्तु भैमा युधि जातहर्षाः॥
en: Then I shall kill all his followers, Duryodhana and all the Kurus. O son of Rohini, let the followers of Bhima look at me with joy when I take up my weapons at the field of battle.

sa: लोमश उवाच एते कलिङ्गाः कौन्तेय यत्र वैतरणी नदी। यत्रायजतधर्मोऽपि देवाञ्छरणमेत्य वै॥
en: Lomasha said: O son of Kunti, this is Kalinga where flows the river Vaitarani, where (on the banks of which) Dharma performed sacrifices under the protection of the celestials.

sa: गदोल्मुको बाहुकभानुनीथाः शूरच संख्ये निशथः कुमारः। रणोत्कटौ सारणचारुदेष्णौ कुलोचितं विप्रथयन्तु कर्म॥
en: Gada, Ulmuka, Bahuka, Bhanu, Nitha and heroic in battle but young in age, Nishatha, Sarana and Charudeshna, irresistible in war, let all of them perform feats befitting their race.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच सा निहत्य मृगव्याधं प्रतस्थे कमलेक्षणा। वनं प्रतिभयं शून्यं झिल्लिकागणनादितम्॥
en: Brihadashva said: Thus having slain the huntsman she, of eyes resembling lotus leaves, entered deeper and deeper into that desolate and dreadful forest, echoing with the jingling of crickets.

sa: द्विधेव हृदयं तस्य दुःखितस्याभवत् तदा। दोलेव मुहुरायाति याति चैव सभां प्रति॥
en: It seemed as if the heart of the distressed king was divided in twain, who like a rocking cradle repeatedly went away from and came back into the inn,

sa: शकुनिरुवाच बहु वित्तं पराजैषीः पाण्डवानां युधिष्ठिर। आचक्ष्व वित्तं कौन्तेय यदि तेऽस्त्यपराजितम्॥
en: Shakuni said O Yudhisthira, you have lost much wealth of the Pandavas. O son of Kunti, if you have any other wealth which is not yet lost, tell us.

sa: लोमश उवाच ततः शुश्राव शर्यातिर्वयस्थं च्यवनं कृतम्। सुहृष्टः सेनया सार्धमुपायाद् भार्गवाश्रमम्॥
en: Lomasha said: Thereupon hearing that Chyavana had been turned into a youth, Sharyati, becoming very much pleased, came with his troops to the hermitage of the son of Bhrigu.

sa: समृद्धरूपः सवितेव दीप्तः सुश्लक्ष्णकृष्णाक्षिरतीव गौरः। नीलः प्रसन्नाश्च जटाः सुगन्धा हिरण्यरज्जुग्रथिताः सुदीर्घाः॥
en: His exceeding beauty was blazing like the sun, his eyes were very graceful and black. His matted locks were blue, fragrant, long and tied up with strings of gold.

sa: दुर्योधनः शकुनिः सूतपुत्रो दुःशासनश्चापि सुमन्दचेताः। मधु प्रपश्यन्ति न तु प्रपातं यद् द्यूतमालम्ब्य हरन्ति राज्यम्॥
en: Alas, Duryodhana and Shakuni and Suta's son (Karna) and the wicked minded Duhshasana in robbing the Pandavas of their kingdom by means of dice saw only honey (on the tree) without thinking the terrible fall from it!

sa: येनाजयद् देवपतिर्बलिं वैरोचनि पुरा। ततो देवाः सर्व एव तेन घोषेण बोधिताः॥
en: Riding which, in days of yore the king of the gods conquered Bali, the son of Virochana. Then all the gods, being aroused by the sound of that car,

sa: यदि मां धर्मराजश्च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। युक्तं परमया लक्ष्या पश्येतां जीवितं भवेत्॥
en: If king Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), Bhima and the son of Pandu (Arjuna) see me graced with great prosperity, then only shall I attain to the great end of my life.

sa: यावच्च मेधरिष्यन्ति प्राणा देहे शुचिस्मिते। तावत् त्वयि भविष्यामि सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O you of blameless smiles, I truly promise to you that as long as my life will reside in my body, till then I will continue to be yours.

sa: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि गन्धर्वाः शीघ्रगामिनः। तथा किंपुरुषा राजन् यक्षाश्चैव चतुर्गुणाः॥ अनेकरूपसंस्थाना नानाप्रहरणाश्च ते। यक्षेन्द्रं मनुजश्रेष्ठ माणिभद्रमुपासते॥
en: O king, O foremost of men, here at this place eight thousand swift-going Gandharvas and as many Kimpurushes and four times as many Yakshas of various shapes, wielding many weapons, wait upon the chief of Yaksha Manivadra.

sa: मुत्थाय सर्वं स्वयमेव कार्यम्। जानातु कृष्णस्तव भावमेतं सर्वात्मना मां भजतीति सत्ये॥
en: O Satyabhama, when he orders a maidservant to do any thing, soon get up and do it yourself. Let Krishna know that you adore him with all your heart.

sa: ये नैव विद्यां न तपो न दानं मूढाः प्रजने यतन्ति। स्तेषामयं नैव परच लोकः॥
en: And those stupid persons who have neither learning nor asceticism, nor charity and who do not multiply their kind and are not given to worldly joys attain to happiness neither in this world nor in the next.

sa: संजय उवाच अवाप्य वसुसम्पूर्णां वसुधां वसुधाधिप। प्रव्राज्य पाण्डवान् राज्याद् राजन् किमनुशोचसि॥
en: Sanjaya said O lord of the world, you have (now) obtained the whole earth with all its wealth; you have banished the Pandavas, why then do you grieve so?

sa: राजन् निवेशे बुद्धिर्मे वर्तते पुत्रकारणात्। वरये त्वां महीपाल लोपामुद्रां प्रयच्छ मे॥
en: O king, I have a mind to lead a domestic life for the sake of begetting offspring. O ruler of carth, therefore bestow on me Lopamudra; I solicit her.

sa: प्रयागं जघनस्थानमुपस्थमृषयो विदुः। प्रयागं सप्रतिष्ठानं कम्बलाश्वतरौ तथा॥ तीर्थं भोगवती चैव वेदिरेषा प्रजापतेः। तत्र वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च मूर्तिमन्तो युधिष्ठिर॥ प्रजापतिमुपासन्ते ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। यजन्ते क्रतुभिर्देवास्तथा चक्रधरा नृपाः॥ तत: पुण्यतमं नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत। प्रयागं सर्वतीर्थभ्यः प्रवदन्त्यधिकं विभो॥ गमनात् तस्य तीर्थस्य नामसंकीर्तनादपि। मृत्युकालभयाच्चापि नर: पापात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: And Prayaga is known as the foremost point of that region. Prayaga, Sapratishanta, Kamvala, Asvatari and the Tirtha Bhogavati are the sacrificial altars of Prajapati (Brahma). O hero steady in war, the Vedas and the sacrifices in their embodied forms and also ascetic Rishis adore here Prajapati (Brahma). Here the celestials and the rulers of kingdoms perform their sacrifices. O descendant of Bharata, O lord, therefore Prayaga is the most sacred of all the Tirthas, in fact it is the foremost of all the Tirthas in the three worlds. Going to that Tirtha and singing its name and taking a little carth from it, one is cleansed of all his sins.

sa: ततः प्रहसिताः सर्वे तेऽन्योन्यस्य तलान् ददुः। तदेव च विनिश्चित्य ददृशुः कुरुसत्तमम्॥
en: They then all three laughed together and gave their hands to one another. Having arrived at this conclusion, they then went to see the chief of the Kurus (Dhritarashtra).

sa: पुण्या द्वारवती तत्र यत्रासौ मधुसूदनः। साक्षाद् देवः पुराणोऽसौ स हिधर्मः सनातनः॥
en: There is also Daravati which produces great merit and in which lives the slayer of Madhu who is the ancient one in embodied form and who is eternal virtue.

sa: अथाभिदुत्य महिषो देवांश्चिक्षेप तं गिरिम्॥ पतता तेन गिरिणा देवसैन्यस्य पार्थिव। भीमरूपेण निहतमयुतं प्रापतद् भुवि॥
en: But they were pursued by Mahisha who hurled on them the rock. O ruler of earth, by the falling of that rock, ten thousand warriors of the celestials army were killed by being crushed to the ground.

sa: सत्त्वेन कुरुते युद्धं राजन् सुबलवानपि। नोद्यमेन न होत्राभिः सर्वाः स्वीकुरुते प्रजाः॥
en: O king, those that are strong engage in battle by depending on their own courage. They do not conquer people by continued efforts or by the arts of conciliation.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं मान्धातुश्चरितं महत्। जन्म चाचयं महीपाल यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: O ruler of earth, I have thus narrated to you all the great history of Mandhata, the manner in which he was born, a birth which was surely wonderful.”

sa: ददस्व शर्म प्रविविक्षतोऽस्य शैलानिमाछैलसुते नृपम्य। उक्त्वा तथा सागरगां स विप्रो यत्तो भवस्वेति शशास पार्थम्॥
en: O daughter of the mountain, this king is about to enter this mountainous regions. Therefore confer upon him your protection." Having thus addressed that ocean-going river, that Brahinana said to the son of Pritha to be careful.

sa: विदुस्त्वां सर्वभूतानि पार्थ भूतहिते रतम्। निर्भयश्चापि शैलाचे वस त्वं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: O Partha, all the creatures are aware that you are actively intent on the welfare of the whole creation. (Therefore) dwell on the summit of this mountain without fear.

sa: उपपन्ना त्वया भैमी त्वं च भैम्या महीपते। नात्र शङ्का त्वया कार्या संगच्छ सह भार्यया॥
en: O ruler of the earth, the daughter of king Bhima has been obtained by you; as also you have been obtained by Bhaimi. You should hold no doubt about her conduct. Be you united with your consort."

sa: महर्षे मम पुत्रोऽयं कुन्त्यां जातो महाभुजः। अस्त्रहेतोरिह प्राप्तः कस्पाच्चित् कारणान्तरात्॥ अहो नैनं भवान् वेत्ति पुराणमृषिसत्तमम्। शृणु मे वदतो ब्रह्मन् योऽयं यच्चास्य कारणम्॥
en: O great Rishi, this mighty-armed hero is my son, born (in the womb) of Kunti. He has come here to obtain weapons. For what wonderful reason. Alas, you do not recognise him as the excellent Rishi of old! O Brahmana, listen to me, I shall tell you who he is and for what reason he has come here.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच स्थितोऽस्मि शासने भ्रातुर्विदुरस्य महात्मनः। तेन संगम्य वेत्स्यामि कार्यस्यास्य विनिश्चयम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said I am always obedient to the counsel of my brother, the high-souled Vidura. After consulting with him, I shall settle what should be done in this matter.

sa: ततो रथसहस्राणि षष्टिस्तेषाममर्षिणाम्। युयुत्सूनां मया सार्धं पर्यवर्तन्त भारत। तान्यहं निशितैर्बाणैर्व्यधमं गार्धराजितैः॥
en: O Bharata, then, desirous of fighting with me, they furiously hemmed me in with sixty thousand cars. (But) I destroyed those (cars) by sharpened arrows adorned with vulture feathers.

sa: तास्तु सर्वाः प्रकृतयो द्वितीयं समुपस्थिताः। न्यवेदयद् भीमसुता न च तत् प्रत्यनन्दत॥
en: When again the daughter of Bhima informed Nala, that all his subjects came there in a body for the second time, the king said nothing to her in reply.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रान् रणे हत्वा मिषतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। शां गन्तास्मि नवरात् सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I tell you truly that killing the sons of Dhritarashtra in battle in the presence of all the warriors, I shall without the least delay pacify my this anger.

sa: रथं तं तु समाश्लिष्य प्राद्रवद् रथयोगवित्। त्रासयन् रथघोषेण तत् पुरं समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Expert in driving the car and sitting steadily on it, drove it with force. And he drove onward making that city resound with the rattling sound of the car.

sa: कदा नु खलु दुःखस्य पारं यास्यति वै शुभा। भर्तुः समागमात् साध्वी रोहिणी शशिनो यथा॥
en: When, after sometime, the auspicious lady will surely have bridged over this ocean of woe, then she, devoted to her husband as ever, will, in company with her lord, look like Rohini in company with the Moon.

sa: ततः सम्पीड्यमानास्ते बलेन महता तदा। प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीता ये च राजञ्जिगीषवः॥
en: Being thus attacked with great force the Kuru army was afflicted and it was with panic, O king, those that desired to live fled from the field (of battle).

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच निवर्तयिष्यति त्वासौ यदि क्षत्ता समेष्यति। निवृत्ते त्वयि राजेन्द्र मरिष्येऽहमसंशयम्॥
en: Duryodhana said If you consult with Kshatta (Vidura) he will make you desist (from it). O king of kings, if you desist (from this), I will certainly kill myself.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः प्रयातः कौन्तेयः क्रमेण भरतर्षभ। नन्दामपरनन्दां च नद्यौ पापभयापहे॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of the Bharata race, then slowly did the son of Kunti to the two rivers Nanda and Aparananda which destroys the dread of fear.

sa: एकः कथंचिदुत्पन्नः पुत्रो जन्तुरयं मम। यतमानासु सर्वासु किं नु दुःखमतः परम्॥
en: Having tried every means and put forth great efforts they have (at last) given birth to this one single son, Jantu. What greater grief can there be than this!

sa: यां न वायुर्न चादित्यो दृष्टवन्तौ पुरा गृहे। साहमद्य सभामध्ये दृश्यास्मि जनसंसदि॥
en: She, who is never before seen by even the wind and the sun in her house, is seen to day in the assembly and is exposed before all men.

sa: लोमश उवाच इह मास्तनूस्त्यक्तवा स्वर्गं गच्छन्ति भारता मर्तुकामा नरा राजनिहायान्ति सहस्रशः॥
en: Lomasha said: O descendant of Bharata, if men give up their bodies here, they go to heaven. O king, thousands of men come here with the desire to die.

sa: यत्र देववनं पुण्यं तापसैरुपशोभितम्॥ बाहुदा च नदी यत्र नन्दा च गिरिमूर्धनि।
en: In this place is also the charming Devavana, grand with the presence of ascetics. In this place also are rivers Bahuda and Nanda on the top of the mountains.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽपि दुष्टात्मा नैव भागं व्यमुञ्चत। दण्डं चतुर्थं पश्यामि तेषु पापेषु नान्यथा॥
en: Even thus spoken to the wicked-souled one did not give up any share and I can only see the forth means (punishment) for these wickedsouled ones and nothing else.

sa: स्थिताः शुश्रूषितुं पार्थाः स्थिता योद्भुमरिंदमाः। यत् कृत्यं धृतराष्ट्रस्य तत् करोतु नराधिपः॥
en: The sons of Pritha are ready to attend on Dhritarashtra; the subduers of foes are ready for fight. Let the king (Yudhishthira) do what Dhritarashtra is going to do.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच न पर्यायोऽस्ति यद् राजश्रियं निष्केवलामहम्। तैः सहेमामुपाश्नीयां यावज्जीवं पितामह॥
en: Duryodhana said Since, O king, there is no likelihood of my being the sole enjoy of royalty and since, O grandsire, I cannot share it for life with them.

sa: निर्वनो वध्यते व्याघ्रो निर्व्याघ्रं छिद्यते वनम्। तस्माद् व्याघ्रो वनं रक्षेद् वनं व्याघ्रं च पालयेत्॥
en: The tiger without the forest (to protect it) is easily killed and so is the forest without tigers in it (to overawe people) easily cut down. The tiger therefore protects the forest and the forest the tiger.

sa: यत् तद् विराटनगरे श्रुयते महदद्भुतम्। एकस्य च बहूनां च पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: The greatly wonderful event, which is heard to have taken place in the city of Virata of a fight of one against many, is a sufficient proof of this.

sa: यदि ह्यद्य न गच्छेयं द्वैरथं सव्यसाचिना। अकीर्तिः स्याद्धृषीकेश मम पार्थस्य चोभयोः॥
en: If I do not fight with Savyasachi now in a single fight, then will infamy be mine, O Hrishikesha, and of the son of Pritha, in fact of both.

sa: न मे देवमनुष्येषु गुणकेश्याः समो वरः। रूपतो दृश्यते कश्चिन्नागेषु भविता ध्रुवम्॥
en: Matali said Among gods and men I d not find a suitable husband for Gunakeshi in point of beauty. There must be some one so suitable among the Nagas.

sa: देवमानुषलोकौ द्वौ मानुषेणैव चक्षुषा। अवगाह्मैव विचितौ न च मे रोचते वरः॥
en: By my human eyes have I searched the two worlds, those of the celestial and human beings and there is no suitable husband for my daughter that pleases me.

sa: लेखा शशिनि भा: सूर्ये महोर्मिरिव सागरे। धर्मस्त्वयि तथा राजनिति व्यवसिताः प्रजाः॥
en: The subjects are confident that virtue resides in you, O king permanently even as marks on the stone or as rays in the sun and waves in the sea.

sa: सर्वमस्मिन् गृहे रत्नं मम दुर्योधनस्य च। यद् यदर्हति वार्ष्णेयस्तत् तद् देयमसंशयम्॥
en: All my wealth and that of Duryodhana are in this house. Whatever is fitting for the scion of the Vrishni race should be given to him without doubt TARAAVML+V40

sa: द्यूतमेतत् पुराकल्पे दृष्टं वैरकरं नृणाम्। तस्माद् द्यूतं न सेवेत हास्यार्थमपि बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Gambling, from the early ages has been seen to be the cause of enmity among men; therefore it should not be resorted to even in jests by the wise.

sa: श्रोतव्यं हितकामानां सुहृदां हितमिच्छताम्। न कर्तव्यो हि निर्बन्धो निर्बन्धो हि क्षयोदयः॥
en: The advice of your well wishers should be listened to by you, for your friends wise you well; obstinacy should not be resorted for it gives rise to ruin.

sa: द्युमत्सेन उवाच यतः प्रभृति सावित्री पित्रा दत्ता स्नुषा मम। नानयाभ्यर्थनायुक्तमुक्तपूर्वं स्मराम्यहम्॥
en: Dyumatsena said : From the very time that Savitri was made my daughter-in-law by her father, I do not remember her to have ever made any request to me.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच तस्यैव वरदानेन धर्मस्य मनुजाधिप। अज्ञाता विचरिष्यामो नराणां नात्र संशयः॥
en: Arjuna said O lord of men, by virtue of Dharma's gift of boon we shall to about without being known to the people. There is no doubt of it.

sa: सर्वं जगदिदं तात विदितं ते परंतप। दिष्ट्या कृच्छ्रमिदं राजन् पारितं भरतर्षभ॥
en: O son, everything connected with this world is known to you. O king, O you best among the race of Bharata, it is fortunate that this trouble is past.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच अथ मद्राधिपो राजा नारदेन समागतः। उपविष्टः सभामध्ये कथायोगेन भारत॥
en: Markandeya said : OBharata, (one day) when that monarch, the king of the Madra, joined by Narada and seated in the midst of his court, was conversing with him.

sa: द्रौपयुवाच इदं तु ते महद् दुःखं यत् प्रवक्ष्यामि भारत। न मेऽभ्यसूया कर्तव्या दुःखादेतद् ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Draupadi said O Bharata, what I am going to tell you now is another great grief of mine; you should not get angry with me, as I tell you this out of a sheer sadness of heart.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अतिथिः सर्वभूतानामग्निः सोमो गवामृतम्। सनातनोऽमृतो धर्मो वायुः सर्वमिदं जगत्॥
en: Yudhishthira replied Agni is the guest of all creatures; the milk of the cows is Amrita; Homa with Amrita is the eternal religion; and air is this entire universe.

sa: अर्धं हि राज्यस्य विसृज्य वीराः कुन्तीसुतास्तस्य कृते यतन्ते। प्रदाय चार्घं धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः सुखी सहास्माभिरतीव मोदेत्॥
en: The heroic sons of Kunti, being willing to forego half of their kingdom, are trying to get the other half, the son of Dhritarashtra too should give up half and pass his days very happily with us.

sa: न च तेऽयं समारम्भो मयि मोघो भविष्यति। वध्यान् विषह्यान् संग्रामे न हनिष्यामि ते सुतान्॥
en: But at the same time this appeal to me by you shall not be entirely useless. I shall not kill such of your sons as are capable of being withstood and killed by me, in the battle.

sa: कुलवृद्धिं च राजेन्द्र तस्मात् साधु समाचर। श्रेयसा योक्ष्यते राजन् कुर्वाणो ज्ञातिसक्रियाम्॥
en: Therefore do you that, О chief among kings, which will effect an increase of your family; by doing good to your relatives, O monarch, you will meet with prosperity.

sa: श्राद्धं पितृभ्यो न ददाति दैवतानि न चार्चति। सुहन्मित्रं न लभते तमाहुर्मूढचेतसम्॥
en: He is said to be foolish-minded who dose not give offerings to his ancestors, (Pitris), who dose not worship gods and who dose not (manage to) get good-hearted friends.

sa: सम्प्राप्नुवन्त्वद्य सहैव दैवतै रिपुं जयाम तं नहुषं घोरदृष्टिम्। ततः शक्रं ज्वलनोऽप्याह भागं प्रयच्छ मह्यं तव साह्यं करिष्ये। तमाह शक्रो भविताग्ने तवापि चेन्द्राग्न्योर्वे भाग एको महाक्रतौ॥
en: Coming together, shall we this day, with the aid of the gods, win victory over our enemy, Nahusha, of terrific gaze. Then the god of fire said to Shakra-"give me a share, I shall render you assistance" and Indra said to him; "O God of fire, you too shall get a share; in large sacrificial ceremonies, there will be but one share for Indra and Agni."

sa: सोऽयं शोकेन महता तप्यमानो द्विजर्षभः। अशक्तः प्रतिकर्तुं तद् भवन्तं शरणं गतः॥
en: This best among the twice born, is for this reason, being consumed by heavy grief being unable to redeem his pledge and therefore he has come under your protection.

sa: देवदूत उवाच महर्षे आर्यबुद्धिस्त्वं यः स्वर्गसुखमुत्तमम्। सम्प्राप्तं बहु मन्तव्यं विमृशस्यबुधो यथा॥
en: The celestial messenger said: O great Rishi, you are very simple, for having obtained that celestial bliss which brings great honour, you are still delebrating like an unwise person.

sa: स महात्मा महावेगः कुम्भकर्णस्य मूर्धनि॥ बिभेद शालं सुग्रीवो न चैवाव्यथयत् कपिः।
en: And though that large-hearted monkey, Sugriva endued with a great speed, broke that Sala tree on the head of Kumbhakarna, yet he could not afflict him (in the least).

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच उदकं मधुपर्क वाप्यानयन्तु सुधन्वने। ब्रह्मन्नभ्यर्चनीयोऽसि श्वेता गौः पीवरी कृता।॥
en: Prahrada said Let water, honey and curds be brought for Sudhanvan. O Brahmana, you ought to be respected by ine. A white and healthy cow is ready for you.

sa: अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तो मित्राणां मित्रवत्सला न च त्वदन्यं पश्यामि यो न आपत्सु तारयेत्॥
en: This is the time arrived for friends (to show that they are so), O you devoted to the interests of your friends. Any other save yourself I do not see, who could get us through this difficulty.

sa: न चापि मम पर्याप्ताः सहिताः सर्वपार्थिवाः। क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुख स्थातु सिंहस्येवेतरे मृगाः॥
en: Otherwise I tell you that not even all the rulers of the earth united together are capable of standing in my front like other animals before an enraged lion.

sa: त्वय्यधीनः शमो राजन् मयि चैव विशाम्पते। पुत्रान् स्थापय कौरव्य स्थापयिष्याम्यहं परान्॥
en: Peace depends on you, o king and on myself as well, O lord of the universe. ) Kaurava, set right your sons and I shall the enemies (Pandavas) right.

sa: द्वे मे शते संनिहिते हयानां यद्विधास्तव। एष्टव्याः शतशस्त्वन्ये चरन्ति मम वाजिनः॥
en: “The kind of horses that you require, two hundred only I have; got; hundreds of other breeds of horses, all worthy of sacrifice, are roaming about (in my kingdom)

sa: तं तदा मन्युरेवैति स भूयः सम्प्रमुह्यति। स मोहवशमापन्नः क्रूरं कर्म निषेवते॥
en: Ever subject to outbursts of passion, he sometimes loses his senses and getting himself under the control of his folly he attaches himself to the performance of evil deeds.

sa: मङ्गल्याः पुण्यनिर्घोषा वाचः शृण्वंश्च सूनृताः। ब्राह्मणानां प्रतीतानामृषीणामिव वासवः॥ कृत्वा पौर्वाह्निकं कृत्यं स्नातः शुचिरलंकृतः। उपतस्थे विवस्वन्तं पावकं च जनार्दनः॥ ऋषभं पृष्ठ आलभ्य ब्राह्मणानभिवाद्य च। अग्नि प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा पश्यन् कल्याणमग्रतः॥ तत् प्रतिज्ञाय वचनं पाण्डवस्य जनार्दनः। शिने प्तारमासीनमभ्यभाषत सात्यकिम्॥
en: (Janardana) listening to auspicious and lily sounding words by the Brahmanas, like Vasava hearing the prayers of the Rishis and having performed the customary rites of the morning and after a bath wearing holy ornaments, worshipped the sun and the fire, having touched the tail of a bull and having paid due respect to the Brahmanas and going round the fire and looking an auspicious object placed before him, Janardana addressed Satyaki, the grandson of Shirii, who was seated near, after knowing the exact wishes of the Pandava (Yudhishthira), sayingरथ आरोप्यतां शङ्खश्चक्रं च गदया सह।

sa: न त्वेनं पीडयामास बलेन बलवत्तरः। ततो हि जीवितं तस्य न व्यनीनशदच्युतः॥
en: The one who was by far the stronger did not press him (Garuda) with any force and thus was he alive for Achyuta did not want to kill him.

sa: स विष्णु शिरसा पक्षी प्रणम्य विनतासुतः। विचेता विह्वलो दीन: किंचिद् वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the bird, the son of Vinata, bowed with his head to Vishnu and feebly said to him these words, being stupefied and rendered helpless and regretting his folly.

sa: अश्वपतिरुवाच कार्येण खल्वनेनैव प्रेषितायैव चागता। एतस्याः शृणु देवर्षे भर्तारं योऽनया वृतः॥
en: Ashyapati said : She was sent on that very business and she is just now come. Hear, O divine sage, from her, whom she has chosen for her husband.

sa: वृत्तं यत्नेन संरक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणेन विशेषतः। अक्षीणवृत्तो न क्षीणो वृत्ततस्तु हतो हतः॥
en: One, especially a Brahmana, should very carefully maintain his character. One whose character is not weak is never weakened. But he that has lost his character is himself lost.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रिये पुढे निपातिते। निर्ययौ रथमास्थाय हेमरत्नविभूषितम्॥
en: Markandeya said : Then, angry at the death of his dear son, the ten-necked, ascending his car, studded with gems and gold set out (for the field of battle).

sa: धर्मनित्यः प्रशान्तात्मा कार्ययोगवहः सदा। नाधर्मं कुरुते बुद्धिं न च पापे प्रवर्तते॥
en: That clam soul, ever engaged in the practice of virtue and ever attached to action after mature thought, never turns his mind towards vice, nor ever turns to sin.

sa: तस्मादिच्छन्ति दौहित्रान् यथा त्वं वसुधाधिप। ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे शिरसा जननीं तदा॥
en: Therefore was it that you, O lord of the earth, wished me to be the mother of son;" then did all those rulers of the earth lowering their heads,

sa: नकुल उवाच पञ्चानां पाण्डुपुत्राणां ज्येष्ठो भ्राता युधिष्ठिरः। तेनाहमश्वेषु पुरा नियुक्तः शत्रुकर्शन॥
en: Nakula said O repressor of foes, of the five sons of Pandu, Yudhishthira is the eldest brother, by him I was formerly employed as a keeper of his horses.

sa: ब्रवीमि यदहं देवास्तत् सर्वं क्रियते यदि। ततः सर्वं करिष्यामि यदूचुर्मी द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: O gods, if you do all that I am going to say then shall I do all that you have said to me, O foremost among the twice born.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचो राजन् कर्णस्य भरतर्षभ। प्रीत्या परमया युक्तः कर्णमाह नराधिपः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O king, O foremost of the Bharata race, having heard these words of Karna, that lord of men became exceedingly delighted and he thus spoke to Karna.

sa: जयन् वावध्यमानो वा प्राप्नोतीन्द्रसलोकताम्। न शक्रभवने पुण्ये दिवि तद् विद्यते सुखम्।
en: Whether he is victorious or is slain he attains to the world of Indra. And that happiness does not exist in heaven or in the sacred region of Indra;

sa: पुनरुक्तं च वक्ष्यामि विश्रम्मेण जनार्दन। का तु सीमन्तिनी मादृक् पृथिव्यामस्ति केशव॥
en: Out of excessive confidence on you, O Janardana, that I repeat what has been already repeated again and again. What woman is there in this world equal to me?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स ददर्श हतान् भ्रातृन् लोकपालानिव च्युतान्। युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते शक्रप्रतिमगौरवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : He (Yudhishthira) then beheld his brothers, glorious as Shakra himself, lying dead like the Lokapalas dropped down form their regions at the end of a Yuga.

sa: हेममाली ततो वाली तारां ताराधिपाननाम्। प्रोवाच वचनं वाग्मी तां वानरपतिः पतिः॥
en: Thereupon, (her) husband, the eloquent Bali, the monkey-king who wore a golden garland replied to Tara endued with a face resplendent as the moon, the lord of the stars.

sa: महान्तमप्यर्थमधर्मयुक्तं यः संत्यजत्यनपाकृष्ट एव। सुखं सुदुःखान्यवमुच्य शेते जीर्णां त्वचं सर्प इवावमुच्य॥
en: He who forsakes, without any inducement, a grand object which is fraught with unrighteousness, lies in happiness free from misery like a snake casting off the worn out slough.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच वसमानेषु पार्थेषु वने तस्मिन् महात्मसु। धार्तराष्ट्रा महेष्वासाः किमकुर्वत सत्तमाः॥
en: Janamejaya said : When the illustrious sons of Pritha were living in the forest, what did those foremost of men and mighty bow-men, the the sons of Dhritarashtra do?

sa: यक्ष उवाच अहं ते जनकस्तात् धर्मोऽमृदुपराक्रम। त्वां दिदृक्षुरनुप्राप्तो विद्धि मां भरतर्षभ॥
en: The Yaksha said: O child, I am your father Dharma of great strength. Know, O best of the Bharatas, that I have come with the intention on seeing you.

sa: दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं यदा पास्यति पाण्डवः। आन नर्दतः सम्यक् तदा सूयं भविष्यति॥
en: When the sons of Pandu will drink the blood of Dushashana repeatedly making loud roars, then will the drinking of the Soma juice of the sacrifice have been finished.

sa: तद् वासो दर्शयामासुस्तस्य कार्ये निवेदिते। वानराणां तु यत् सीता ह्रियमाणा व्यपासृजत्॥
en: When Rama had unfolded his intentions to him, he (Sugriva) showed to him the piece of cloth dropped among the monkeys by Şita while being carried off (by Ravana).

sa: वाच्यः पितामहो वृद्धो ये च कृष्ण सभासदः। भ्रातृणामस्तु सौभ्रात्रं धार्तराष्ट्रः प्रशाम्यताम्॥
en: Our grandfather and those courtiers, who are aged, O Krishna, should be spoken to. Let there be brotherly feeling among the brothers and peace to the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच सकृदंशो निपतति सकृत् कन्या प्रदीयते। सकृदाह ददानीति त्रीण्येतानि सकृत् सकृत्॥
en: Savitri said: The die falls but once and the daughter can once be bestowed. The words "I bestow" are uttered but once and once only these three things occur.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दुर्योधनस्तस्य तु तन्निशम्य पितामहस्यात्महितं वचोऽथ। अतीतकामो युधि सोऽत्यमर्षी राजा विनिःश्वस्य बभूव तूष्णीम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said-O Janamejaya! King Duryodhana gave up an idea to continue fight any more following the advice of grand-father in his interest. He kept mum in the matter sobbing deep with in heart for the humiliation suffered.

sa: कर्णसौबलयोश्चापि संश्रुत्य वचनान्यसौ॥ निर्वेदं परमं गत्वा राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा। व्रीडयाभिपरीतात्मा नैराश्यमगमत् परम्॥
en: Having heard the words of Karna and Subala's son (Shakuni), the king Duryodhana was overwhelmed with shame. He lost heart more than ever and utter despair overtook his soul.

sa: राष्ट्राणि धनधान्यं च प्रयुक्तः परमोपधिः। स तामवस्थां सम्प्राप्य कृष्णां प्रेक्ष्य सभागताम्॥
en: Of his kingdom, wealth and coin by means of a great deceit. He, even when he was brought to that condition, namely when Krishna was dragged to the Assembly-Hall.

sa: ततो ददृशतुस्तौ तं छिन्नपक्षद्वयं खगम्। तयोः शशंस गृध्रस्तु सीतार्थे रावणाद् वधम्॥
en: Then they both beheld the bird with its wings cut off; and the vulture related to him as to how he came by death while attempting to rescue Sita.

sa: अपि वज्रधरः साक्षात् किमुतान्ये धनुर्भृतः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां समर्थ इति मे मतिः॥
en: Even the holder of the thunderbolt himself (cannot withstand him) how can others bearing the bow? He is capable of standing against the three worlds; this is my opinion.

sa: विराटः सह पुत्राभ्यां शङ्खनैवोत्तरेण च। सूर्यदत्तादिभिर्वीरैर्मदिराक्षपुरोगमैः॥ सहितः पृथिवीपालो भ्रातृभिस्तनयैस्तथा। अक्षौहिण्यैव सैन्यानां वृतः पार्थं समाश्रितः॥
en: Virata, too, with his two sons Shankha and Uttara and with the heroes Suryadatta and others headed by Madiraksha and with his brother and sons, surrounded by an Akshauhini of troops, has joined the son of Pritha.

sa: कर्तव्यं हि कृतं राजन् पाण्डवैस्तव मोक्षणम्। नित्यमेव प्रियं कार्यं राज्ञो विषयवासिभिः॥
en: O king, the Pandavas did only their duty in rescuing you. Those that reside in the dominions of the king should always do what is agreeable to the king.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच आपगेयं महात्मानं भीष्मं शस्त्रभृतां वरम्। पितामहं भारतानां ध्वजं सर्वमहीक्षिताम्।।।।
en: Janamejaya said The great-souled Bhishma, the foremost among all wielders of weapons, the grandfather of the Bharatas, the flag as it were of all the rulers of the earth,

sa: उच्चावचं दैवयुक्तं रहस्यं दिव्यः प्रश्ना मृगचक्रा मुहूर्ताः। क्षयं महान्तं कुरुसुंजयानां निवेदयन्ते पाण्डवानां जयं च॥
en: Capable of explaining the mysteries of the gods and of answering questions regarding coming events, understanding the signs of the zodiac, prophesying the great overthrow of the Kurus and the Srinjayas and the triumph of the Pandavas.

sa: भविष्यतीदमिति वा यद् ब्रवीमि परंतप। नान्यथा भूतपूर्वं च सत्यवागिति मां विदुः॥
en: It will be as I say, O you subduer of enemies, never before have my words been false; and I have been known as the one of truthful speech.

sa: दिष्ट्या च संधिकामास्ते भ्रातरः कुरुनन्दनाः। दिष्ट्या न युद्धमनसः पाण्डवाः सह बान्धवैः॥
en: And it is lucky that our cousins, the sons of Kuru, desire peace, it is lucky that the sons of Pandu are not desirous of war with their relations.

sa: अकार्यकरणाद् भीतः कार्याणां च विवर्जनात्। अकाले मन्त्रभेदाच्च येन मायेन्न तत् पिबेत्॥
en: He by whom is feared the doing of improper acts or the omission of proper acts or the premature disclosure of his intentions, should not drink that which inebriates.

sa: एष पुत्रो महाप्रज्ञो वरुणस्येह गोपतेः। एष वै शीलवृत्तेन शौचेन च विशिष्यते॥
en: This one is the son, of great wisdom, of Varuna the lord of the seas; he is specially famous for his holiness, his conduct and his ways of life.

sa: ततो मलयमारुह्य पश्यन्तो वरुणालयम्। विषण्णा व्यथिताः खिन्ना निराशा निराशा जीविते भृशम्॥
en: Then ascending the Malaya mountain (when) we beheld the abode of Varuna (i.e. the ocean-god), we became sorely grieved, afflicted and dejected and gave up all hopes of life.

sa: एष कृत्ये समुत्पन्ने तत् तद् धारयते बलम्। सहस्रशतसंख्येन प्राणेन सततं ध्रुवः॥
en: This bow, at the approach of the proper time of action, is endued as it is with the strength of a hundred thousand bows, inspired with still greater strength.

sa: क्रूराय कर्मणे नित्यं प्रजानां परिपालने। शृणु चात्रोपमामेकां या वृद्धेभ्यः श्रुता मया॥
en: For all hard deeds and for the protection of subjects he has been created; hear in this connection an example which has been heard hy me from old people.

sa: विदुर उवाच इह निःश्रेयसं प्राहुर्वृद्धा निश्चितदर्शिनः। ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण दमो धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Vidura said Old persons who are unfailing in their predictions say that in this world self-control is excellent; especially in a Brahmana is it an eternal and necessary virtue.

sa: न जातु गमनं पार्थ भवेत् तत्र निरर्थकम्। अर्थप्राप्तिः कदाचित् स्यादन्ततो वाप्यवाच्यता॥
en: O son of Pritha, my going there shall not be without results. There will be some gain in going there, at least we shall not be blamed by others.

sa: न चातिधैर्येण चरेद् गुरुतां हि व्रजेत् ततः। स्मितं तु मृदुपूर्वेण दर्शयेत प्रसादजम्॥ लाभे न हर्षयेद् यस्तु न व्यथेद् योऽवमानितः। असम्मूढश्च यो नित्यं स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥
en: No person should restrain himself to the reserve, for in that case he should lead him to an unnecessary gravity. But he should smile with modesty and without betraying any mistaken interest as regards real cause of the mirth. He that is always on his guard, and is neither exalted by reward nor feels wronged by disgrace, is alone worthy of residing in a royal palace.

sa: पश्यतां कुरुवीराणां तच्च संस्मारयेः पुनः। पाण्डवान् कुशलं पृच्छेः सपुत्रान् कृष्णया सह॥
en: Offered within the range of the sight of the heroes among the Kurus. Remember that and ask about the health of the Pandavas and of Krishna with her sons.

sa: उपकारो महांस्तात कृतोऽयं मम खेचरैः। कुलं न परिभूतं मे मोक्षणेऽस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: O sir, this is a great kindness that has been shown to me by the Gandharvas. The honour of my family is also saved by liberating the wicked wretch.

sa: तं वै ब्रूहि महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। अर्जुनं पुरुषव्याघ्रं द्रौपद्याः पदवी चर॥
en: O you of long arms, speak to him who is the foremost of all wielders of arms, to Arjuna, that best among men “Follow the path indicated by Draupadi.”

sa: नेच्छामि प्रतिघातं ते नास्मि विघ्नकरस्तव। शृणु चेदं वचो राम श्रुत्वा कर्तव्यमाचर॥
en: "I am neither desirous of throwing any obstacles in your way nor am I inclined to your mischief. O Rama, hear these words and then do what is fit.

sa: स तद् रामाय मेधावी शशंस प्लवगर्षभः। रामश्चाप्यनुमानेन मेने दृष्टां तु मैथिलीम्॥
en: Then that intellectual and foremost of monkeys informed Rama of this. And Rama too inferred (from the statement of Sugriva) that Sita must have been seen (by the monkeys).

sa: उत्तमानेव सेवेत प्राप्तकाले तु मध्यमान्। अधमांस्तु न सेवेत य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: He who desires prosperity for himself should serve good men and, on suitable occasions, men of the middling type; but he should never serve people of the inferior type.

sa: नाहं सहायः पार्थस्य नापि दुर्योधनस्य वै। इति मे निश्चिता बुद्धिर्वासुदेवमवेक्ष्य ह॥
en: I am no helper of either the son of Pritha or that of Duryodhana; such is the unalterable resolution I have come to after the opinion formed by Krishna.

sa: न व्यवस्यन्ति पाण्डूनां प्रदातुं पैतृकं वसु। अहं तु ताञ्छितैर्बाणैरनुनीय रणे बलात्॥
en: They would not now consent to give back the ancestral territories of the Pandavas. And I shall persuade them by means of cold arrows in the field of battle.

sa: अनावृताः स्त्रियः सर्वा नराश्च वरवर्णिनि। स्वभाव एष लोकानां विकारोऽन्य इति स्मृतः॥
en: O fair complexioned girl, it is the human nature that all men and women should be without restraint. And it is asserted that the contrary (condition) is (its) perversion.

sa: एवंगते पाण्डवेयैर्विदितं वः पुरा यथा। न प्राप्तं पैतृकं द्रव्यं धृतराष्ट्रेण संवृतम्॥
en: It is known to you, how in former days, the sons of Pandu, did not obtain their ancestral wealth which was wrested from them by the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: त्वङ्मांसं शोणितं चेति मातृजान्यपि शुश्रुम। एवमेतद् द्विजश्रेष्ठ वेदे शास्त्रे च पठ्यते॥
en: Skin, flesh, and blood, we hear, originate from the mother. Even this, O foremost of twice-born ones, is what may be read of in the Veda and other scriptures.

sa: शापितासि मम प्राणैर्निवर्तस्व जनेन च। अलं जित्वा निवर्तिष्ये तमहं भ्रातरं रणे॥
en: By my life, do you go back with the other members of my household, I shall only return after bringing about the discomfiture of my brother in the battle.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति देवेन्द्रे कौरवेन्द्रे युधिष्ठिरम्। धर्मो विग्रहवान् साक्षादुवाच सुतमात्मनः॥ भो भो राजन् महाप्राज्ञ प्रीतोऽस्मि तव पुत्रका मद्भक्त्या सत्यवाक्यैश्च क्षमया च दमेन च॥
en: While, O Kuru king, the chief of the celestials was saying so to Yudhishthira, the god of Righteousness, in his embodied form, then addressed his own son and said, O king, I am highly pleased, O you of great wisdom, with you, O son, by your devotion to me by your truthfulness of speech, and forgiveness, and self-control.

sa: त्यजति ब्राह्मण: शिष्यान् देवयान्या प्रचोदितः। सायं कामयते कामं स कार्योऽद्य त्वयानघे॥
en: Accomplish the good of your race. Urged by Devayani, the Brahmana (Shukra) is about to leave his disciples (the Asuras). O sinless lady, you must do as Devayani desires."

sa: बहुशः सम्पतन्तीं त्वां जनः संकेतदोषतः। वयं च देशातिथयो गच्छ भद्रे यथासुखम्॥
en: If you come to me very often, people may think evil; because we are men of other country. So, O handsome one, do you go away hence with ease."

sa: गुणा गुणवतः सन्ति निर्गुणस्य कुतो गुणाः। तस्मादेवं विजानन्ति ये जना गुणदर्शिनः॥
en: Those persons who are truly conversant with qualities know that only objects endued with qualities can have attributes but that That which is above all qualities can have none.

sa: सर्प उवाच कार्याभावे क्रिया न स्यात् सत्यसत्यपि कारणे। तस्मात् समेऽस्मिन् हेतौ मे वाच्यो हेतुर्विशेषतः॥
en: The serpent said Whether any prime cause exists or not, no effect is done without an (intermediate) act. Therefore, causation being of no importance in either case, my act as the cause should be considered in full.

sa: कायिकं वाचिकं चैव मनसा समुपार्जितम्। तत् सर्वं नाशमायाति तमः सूर्योदये यथा॥
en: Sins committed by means of the body by means of words and by means of the mind, are all dissipated (through listening to the Bharata) as Darkness at sunrise.

sa: न चापि कृष्णा शक्येत तेभ्यो भेदयितुं परैः। परियूनान् वृतवती किमुताद्य मृजावतः॥
en: We can never succeed in estranging Krishna (Draupadi) from them by any spies. she choose them as her husband when they were in adversity, they are now in prosperity.

sa: अयं ते सुमहान्कालः शयानस्य महाबल। सुषुप्तस्त्वं न जानीये मम रामकृतं भयम्॥
en: O highly powerful one, you have slept away a long space of time. And having been asleep, you did not know the great fear of mine springing from Rama.

sa: तमुवाच ततो राजा धार्तराष्ट्रः प्रतापवान्। मां समीक्षस्व गाङ्गेय कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम्॥
en: Then did the royal son of Dhritarashtra, endued with fame say to him, Look to me, O son of Ganga; the task which has devolved on you is great.

sa: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्ण व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्। दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा धृति न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो॥
en: I can no longer command courage or enjoy peace of mind, seeing your mighty forin which are is touching the very skies, which is fiery radiant, many winged, widely open mouthed and with large and blazing eyes.

sa: सर्वभूतान्यहं देहे पश्यन् मनसि चात्मनः। योगे बुद्धिं श्रुते सत्त्वं मनो ब्रह्मणि धारयन्॥ विहरिष्याम्यनासक्तः सुखी लोकान् निरामयः। यया मां त्वं पुन:वं दुःखेषु प्रणिधास्यसि॥
en: Seeing all creatures in my own body and my own mind, and devoting my reason to Yoga, my life to the instructions of the wise, and soul to Brahma, I shall happily rove through the world, without attachment and without calamities of any kind, so that you may not be able to plunge me again into such sorrows.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा वानरमुखमवज्ञाय स राक्षसः। प्रहासं मुमुचे तत्र सतोय इव तोयदः॥
en: And seeing that one having the face of a monkey, the Raksasas, deriding him, burst out into laughter, and seemed as if a mass of clouds were sending roars.

sa: अप्यन्यं प्राकृतं किंचित् किमु तान् पाण्डवर्षभान्। अमर्षवशमापन्नो न किंचिद् बुध्यते जनः॥
en: Not even an ordinary creature-not to speak to those foremost among men, those sons of Pandu; a man, who is under the influence of wrath, can not discern anything.

sa: स तेषां विधिवत् कृत्वा प्रेतकार्याणि पाण्डवः। सप्तमे दिवसे प्रायाद् रथमारुह्य सत्वरः॥
en: The son of Pandu, having next perforined duly those rites that are done to the manes of the dead, quickly started on the seventh day, mounting on his car.

sa: स हताश्वे रथे तिष्ठन् राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। शक्तिं चिक्षेप वेगेन प्राग्ज्योतिषगजं प्रति॥
en: Standing on his car of which the steeds were slain, that foremost of the Rakshasas endued with prowess hurled at the elephants of Bhagadatta, s Shakti, with great force.

sa: यदनेन कृतं कर्म तेनायं निधनं गतः। विनाशहेतुः कर्मास्य सर्वे कर्मवशा वयम्॥
en: It has met 'with death as the result of its pristine Karma. Its Karma has been the root of its destruction. We all are subject to our respective Karma.

sa: एतच्चैव मतं सत्यं सुहृदोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः। यदि नादास्यसे तात पश्चात् तप्स्यसि भारत॥
en: This is truly the opinion of your friend Krishna, and if you do not accept that, my dear son, you will grieve for it in the end, O Bharata,

sa: पूज्यमानं तु रुद्रेण दृष्ट्वा सर्वे दिवौकसः। रुद्रसूनुं ततः प्राहुर्गुहं गुणवतां वरम्॥
en: As Rudra was seen by all the dwellers of heaven to honour Guha (Skanda), the foremost of all accomplished beings is for this reason called the son of Rudra.

sa: ब्राह्मणत्वं शुभं प्राप्य दुर्लभं योऽवमन्यते। अभोज्यान्नानि चाश्नाति स द्विजत्वात् पतेत वै॥
en: That man who having acquired the sacred position of a Brahmana which is so difficult to acquire, disregards it and eats forbidden food, falls away from his high status.

sa: विभ्रंशिता त्वया हीयं धर्मादास्ते यशस्विनी। परामृष्टां त्वया हीमां को हि गन्तुमिहार्हति॥
en: By you has this lady of spotless fame been robbed of virtue; for touched by you as she has been, for whom would it be proper to marry her?

sa: सर्प उवाच यथा हवींषि जुह्वाना मखे वै लुब्धकर्विजः। न फलं प्राप्नुवन्त्यत्र फलयोगे तथा ह्यहम्॥
en: The serpent said O fowler, as the priests officiating at a sacrifice do not gain the merit of the act by offering oblations of clarified butter to the fire, so should I be considered in this matter.

sa: ब्राह्मण्यं काक्षसे हि त्वं तपश्च पृथिवीपते। अवमन्य नरेन्द्रत्वं देवेन्द्रत्वं च पार्थिव॥
en: You became desirous of obtaining the dignity of a Brahmana and the merit of penances, O king, disregarding the sovereignty of the Earth, nay, the sovereignty of very Heaven.

sa: महत् पूर्वं स्थितो यच प्राणोत्पत्तिस्थितश्च यत्। स्थितलिङ्गश्च यन्नित्यं तस्मात् स्थाणुरिति स्मृतः॥१३३
en: As he is Great and Ancient and is the fountain of life and the cause of its continuance and as his Phallic from is eternal, he is called Sthanu.

sa: न मे दुर्व्याहृतं किंचित्रापि मे दुरनुष्ठितम्। लक्ष्मणो राघवभ्राता क्रुद्धः किमिति चिन्तये॥
en: I have not done him any wrong, nor have I spoken to him any improper word. I do not know why Rāghava's brother Laksmana has become offended with me.

sa: तमश्विनावाहतु:-'प्रीतौ स्वस्तवानया गुरुभक्त्या उपाध्यायस्य ते कार्णायसा दन्ता भवतोऽपि हिरण्मया भविष्यन्ति, चक्षुष्मांश्च भविष्यसीति, श्रेयश्चावाप्स्यसि इति॥
en: The Ashvinis said, “We are pleased with your this devotion to your preceptor. Your teacher's teeth are of black iron, yours will be those of Gold. Your sight will be restored and you will possess good fortune."

sa: भूम्यामहं सर्वकालमेकेनांशेन सर्वदा। वसिष्यामि न संदेहः सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीमि वः॥ । योऽयमंशस्तृतीयो मे स्त्रीषु यौवनशालिषु। त्रिरात्रं दर्पपूर्णासु वसिष्ये दर्पघातिनी॥ हन्तारो ब्राह्मणान्ये तु मृषापूर्वमदूषकान्। तांश्चतुर्थेन भागेन संश्रयिष्ये सरुर्षभाः॥
en: By my second portion I shall live perpetually on lands as Uşara;* I tell you the truth. By my third portion I shall for three nights every month live in youthful women proud of their youth-So that men might not live with them. And by my fourth portion I shall enter into the persons of those who shall slay innocent Bråhmaņas. *(A spot with saline soil.)

sa: किं तु सीताथ वैदेही मैथिली जनकात्मजा। उपतिष्ठेत विवशा रावणेन हृता बलात्॥
en: Or dose Maithili Sītā, daughter to Janaka, sprung in the Vaidehī line, forcibly carried off (by Rāvaņa), and completely in his power, abide by the mandate (of that monarch)?

sa: कुर्यात् कृष्णगतिः : शेषं ज्वलितोऽनिलसारथिः। न तु राजाभिपन्नस्य शेषं क्वचन विद्यते॥
en: The anger of the king, however, leaves not anything to the person who happens to incur it. Everything that belongs to the king should be avoided from a distance.

sa: भीष्म उवाच राजन् विदितधर्मोऽसि सुनिर्णीतार्थसंशयः। बहुश्रुता हि ते विप्रा बहवः पर्युपासिताः॥
en: Bhishma said O king, you know well the duties. All your doubts, again, relating to the science of wealth, have been well solved. You have served many learned Brahmanas.

sa: सोऽपि तं नोतसहेताजौ हन्तुं द्रोणेन रक्षितम्। सोऽहं श्वस्तत् करिष्यामि यथा कुन्तीसुतोऽर्जुनः।।२५
en: Even he will not venture to slay Jayadratha, if he is protected by Drona in battle. I, therefore, will do that in the morrow by which Kunti's son Arjuna.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सुदक्षिणस्तु काम्बोजो रथ एकगुणो मतः तवार्थसिद्धिमाकाङ्क्षन् योत्स्यते समरे परैः॥
en: Bhishma said In my opinion Sudakshina, of Kamboja, is equal to one Ratha and he will fight in the battle with the enemy desiring the success of your objects.

sa: तद्यामस्तत्र यत्रास्ते मारुतो रुक्प्रदो हि नः। मा विनाशं गमिष्याम अप्रसाद्यादिते सुतम्॥
en: Let us therefore go there where the wind, the giver of our afflictions, wait. If we do not please the son of Aditi we shall all meet with destruction.

sa: तस्मिन् हि विजयः कृत्स्नः पाण्डवेन समाहितः। यदि नोऽस्ति कृतं किञ्चिद् यदि दत्तं हुतं यदि॥
en: Indeed Pandu's son (Yudhishthira) has grafted all his hopes of victory on Arjuna. If we have acquired any religious merit, if we have ever given away things in charity, if we have burnt offerings on the fire.

sa: एवमुक्तोऽश्विभ्यां लब्धचक्षुरुपाध्यायसकाशमागम्याभ्यवादयत्॥ आचचक्षे च स चास्य प्रीतिमान् बभूव।। आह चैनम् 'यथाऽश्विनावाहतुस्तथा त्वं श्रेयोऽवाप्स्यसि॥ सर्वे च ते वेदाः प्रतिभास्यन्ति, सर्वाणि च धर्मशास्त्राणि, इति। एषा तस्यापि परीक्षोपमन्योः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the Ashvinis he regained his sight. He then went to his preceptor, saluted him and told him all that had happened. And his preceptor was very much pleased with him and told him that he would obtain immense prosperity as the Ashvinis had said. All the Vedas will shine on him and so also all Dharma Shastras. This was his trial.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ततः कृष्णमभ्यभाषत कौरवः। स्वयं लोक्यं च मामात्य धर्म्यं न्याय्यं च केशव॥
en: Vaishampayana said Saying this the descendant of Kurus said to Krishna "O Keshava, you have said to me what leads to (the attainment of) heaven, to the benefit of the world and which is virtuous and just.

sa: धार्यते हि त्वया ग्रन्थ उभयोर्वेदशास्त्रयोः। न च ग्रन्थस्य तत्त्वज्ञो यथातत्त्वं नरेश्वर॥
en: O lord of kings, you only understand aright the texts of the Vedas and other scriptures without understanding the true senses or meaning of those texts, remembering them fruitlessly.

sa: ब्राह्मणोऽपि महत् क्षेत्रं लोके चरति पादवत्। यत् तत्र बीजं वपति सा कृषिः प्रेत्य भाविनि॥
en: The Brahmana is a great field in this world, a field having feet, for it moves from place to place. He who plants seeds in that field, O beautiful lady, reaps the corps in the next world.

sa: एवं बहुविधं दुःखं मनसा धारयन् बहु। नाध्यगच्छत् तदा पारं शोकस्य कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Having thus indulged in a variety of harassing thoughts in his mind, that foremost of monkeys could not cross over to the other shore (of the sea of distress).

sa: यदि पापमपापं वा तवैतद् विवृतं मया। तन्मे दहन्तं भगवन् व्यपनेतुं त्वमर्हसि॥
en: Whether it is sinful or not so, I have told you the truth. You should. O holy one, satisfy the craving I feel for seeing that son of mine.

sa: वसुभिः सहितं पश्य भीष्मं शान्तनवं नृपम्। द्रोणं बृहस्पतेः पावें गुरुमेनं निशामय॥
en: Look at the royal Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, now in the midst of the Vasus, know that this one by the side of Brihaspati is your preceptor Drona.

sa: एषां ज्यायस्तु कौन्तेय दण्डधारणमुच्यते। बलं हि क्षत्रिये नित्यं बले दण्डः समाहितः॥
en: Of them, O son of Kunti, wielding the rod of chastisement has been declared to be the foremost. A Kshatriya must always have strength, and upon strength depends chastisement.

sa: ऋषीणामवकाशः स्याद् यथा तुष्टिकरो महान्। तस्मिन् कुञ्जे नरः स्नात्वा अग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत्।१११।।
en: It served as a resting place for them and it was very delightful to all of them. Bathing in that Kunja, a man obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: ईदृशैः स महादेवः पूज्यमानो महेश्वरः। स शिवस्तात तेजस्वी प्रसादाद् याति तेऽग्रतः॥
en: That great lord Mahadeva, O Partha, is adored by even these kinds of followers. That Siva, O son, possessed of energy, goes in advance of you through kindness only.

sa: एतान्येव पदान्याहुः पञ्च वृद्धाः प्रशान्तये। एष स्वर्गश्च धर्मश्च सुखं चानुत्तमं मतम्॥
en: The ancients say these are the five means by which perfect tranquility or emancipation could be obtained. These are called Heaven. These are Religion. These form the highest happiness.

sa: मा मैवं पुत्र निर्बन्धं कुरु विप्रेण पार्थिव। जामदग्न्येन समरे योद्धमित्येव भद्यत्॥
en: Do not, my son fight thus with a Brahmana, O ruler of the earth, do not fight with the son of Jamadagni;" it was thus that she reproved me.

sa: मृतश्च स्वर्गमाप्नोति तिर्यक्षु च न जायते। इत्याह भगवान् व्यासः पराशरसुतः प्रभुः॥
en: Such a man, after death, ascends to heaven, and is never born among the intermediate animals or birds. This was said by the powerful Vyasa the son of Parashara."

sa: ते वयं जातसंदेहाः पर्यपृच्छामहे रविम्। क एष दिवमाक्रम्य गतः सूर्य इवापरः॥
en: Filled with confusion, we then addressed the Sun, saying,-O illustrious one, who is this Being who has mixed himself with you and has been charged into your second self.

sa: अतः कष्टतरं किं नु मत्कृते यत् पितामहः। इमामवस्थां गमितः प्रत्यमित्रै रणाजिरे॥
en: What can be more painful than this, that, for me, you, O grandfather have been reduced to this condition by my people fighting against their enemies on the battlefield.

sa: सौवर्णां पृथिवीं कृत्वा य इमां मणिशर्कराम्। विप्रेभ्यः प्राददद् राजा सोऽश्वमेधे महामखे॥
en: Making the earth covered with gold and with pebbles constituted by gems, he gave her away as a present to the Brahmanas during the celebration of his great Horse-sacrifice.

sa: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा त्रिविधं हि नरः सदा। बध्यते बन्धनैः पाशैर्मुच्यतेऽप्यथवा पुनः॥
en: It is by these three, viz., thought, word, and deed, that men become fettered with bonds. It is by the same three that they become freed from these fetters.

sa: कथं च राजा भुक्त्वेमां पृथिवीं सागराम्बराम्॥ पाण्डवानां प्रसादेन भोक्ष्ये राज्यमहं कथम्।
en: Having reigned as the sovereign of this Earth bounded by the ocean, how shall I be able to enjoy, by the favor of the Pandavas, a kingdom in peace?

sa: उद्धवो वा महाबुद्धिवृष्णीनामर्चितो नृप। तदलं पुत्र द्यूतेन छूते भेदो हि दृश्यते॥
en: As the greatly intelligent Udhava (is considered to be the foremost) of the Vrishnis. O son, O prince, have nothing with gambling. Dissension is the evident result of gambling.

sa: निवर्तस्व दशग्रीव शैले क्रीडति शंकरः। सुपर्णनागयक्षाणां देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम्॥ सर्वेषामेव भूतानामगम्यः पर्वतः कृतः।
en: Desist you O Ten-necked one; Śankara sport in the mountain; and (now) He is incapable of being approached by every one, birds, serpents and Yaksas; gods, Gandharvas and Raksasas?

sa: परुषः कत्थनो नीचः कर्णो वैकर्तनस्तव। मन्त्री नेता च बन्धुश्च मानी चात्यन्तमुच्छ्रितः॥
en: This man vain and mean, Karna, the son of Vikartana, who is your adviser guide and friend, and who has been placed in too elevated a position by you,

sa: एवं कृत्वा बलिं सम्यग् दद्याद् भिक्षां द्विजाय वै। अलाभे ब्राह्मणस्याग्नावग्रमुद्धृत्य निक्षिपेत्॥
en: After making these offerings, the householder should make offerings to Brahmanas, and if no Brahmana be present, the first portion of the food should be thrown into the fire.

sa: चराचरस्य जगतः प्रभुः स भगवान् हरः॥ तस्मात् परतरं नान्यत् किंचिदस्ति महेश्वरात्।
en: He is the almighty lord Hara, the Masterruler of the mobile and immobile creation. There is nothing superior to that foremost of gods known by the name of Maheshvara.

sa: सभायां याज्ञसेनी च कृष्टा द्यूते रजस्वला॥ तदैव तावद् दुष्टात्मन् वध्यस्त्वं निरपत्रप।
en: While gambling, you insulted the daughter of Yajnasena, while in her season, in the midst of assembly! Shameless as you are, you should have been killed there and then!

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उक्ताः पितामहेनेह सुर्णस्य विधानतः। विस्तरेण प्रदानस्य ये गुणाः श्रुतिलक्षणाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O grandfather described to me fully the merits of the gift of gold according to the ordinances laid down in the scriptures and the Veda.

sa: नं क्रमेण जरा तात प्रतिपेदे महामुनिम्॥ न चान्वबुध्यत तदा स मुनिर्गुरुवत्सलः।
en: Gradually, in course of time, O son, decrepitude overtook Utanka, that great ascetic. The ascetic, however, on account of his devotion to his prcccptor, was not conscious of it.

sa: ततः प्रोवाच कुशिको भार्यां हर्षसमन्वितः॥ पश्य भद्रे यथा भावाश्चित्रा दृष्टाः सुदुर्लभाः।
en: With a delighted heart, the king addressed his wife saying, see, O amiable one, the various agreeable scenes and sights, occurring nowhere else, which we two have just seen.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सोऽप्यवरण्यमनुप्राप्य पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर। महर्षेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रजा धर्मेण पाल्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Although he had retired into the forest yet, O Yudhishthira, having heard the words of the great Rishi, he began to cherish and protect his subjects righteously.

sa: प्रवासं यदि मे याति भर्ता कार्येण केनचित्। मङ्गलैर्बहुभिर्यक्ता भवामि नियता तदा॥
en: When my husband leaves home for going to a distant place on any errand, I remained at home engaged in various kinds of auspicious deeds for blessing his enterprise.

sa: आयसं हृदयं नूनं मन्दाया मम पुत्रका यत् सूर्यजमपश्यन्त्याः शतधा न विदीर्यते॥
en: Surely, my son, this heart of mine is made of steel, since it does not break into a hundred pieces at not sceing that child born of the SunGod.

sa: स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि मैत्रेय गृहान् साधु व्रजाम्यहम्। एतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं श्रेय एवं भविष्यति॥
en: Bless you, O Maitreya, may you have palaces! I depart hence in peace. Do you remember what I have said. You shall then be able to reap many advantages!

sa: यद् यद्धि किंचित् संधाय पुरुषस्तप्यते तपः। सर्वमेतदवाप्नोति विद्यया चेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that with whatever purpose in view one performs performs one acquires the fruition thereof on account of those penances. The same may be said of knowledge.

sa: ओङ्कारः सर्ववेदानां वचसां प्राण एव च। यदस्मिन् नियतं लोके सर्वं सावित्रिरुच्यते॥
en: The syllable Om is the first of all the Vedas, and the vital air Prana is the first of all winds. Savitri is the first of all religious observances.

sa: मघवा उवाच भगवन् केन दानेन स्वर्गत: सुखमेधते। यदक्षयं महाघु च तद् ब्रूहि वदतां वर॥
en: Maghavat said O illustrious one, by what gift does one succeed in coming to the celestial region and acquiring beatitude? O foremost of speakers, do you tell me of that gift which yields high and eternal merit.

sa: त्वत्तश्च मे प्रियतरः पृथिव्यां नास्ति कश्चन। त्वत्तोऽपि मे प्रियतरा ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ॥
en: On Earth there is nothing, O Yudhishthira, that is dearer to me than you. But, O chief of Bharata's race, the Brahmanas are dearer to me than even you.

sa: वृथा संतर्पितो वह्निः खाण्डवे सव्यसाचिना। उपकारमजानन् स कृतघ्न इति मे मतिः॥
en: In vain was the god of fire pleased at Khandava by Arjuna! Ingrate that he is, forgetting that service, he has burnt to death the mother of his benefactor.

sa: मूले मूलफलं दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः। पितॄन् प्रीणयते चापि गतिमिष्टां च गच्छति॥
en: By making to Brahmanas a gift under the constellation Mula, of fruits and roots, with a controlled soul, one pleases the departed manes and attains to a desirable end.

sa: यदि राज्यं यदि धनं यदि गाः संशितव्रत। यज्ञदानानि च तथा ब्रूहि सर्वं ददामि ते॥
en: If it is our kingdom or riches or kine, O you of rigid vows, or all articles that are given away in sacrifices, which you want, tell us the word and we shall bestow all upon you.

sa: भीष्म उवाच सर्वान् कामान् प्रयच्छन्ति ये प्रयच्छन्ति काञ्चनम्। इत्येवं भगवानत्रिः पितामहसुतोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said The illustrious Atri, the son of the Grandfather Brahman, said, They who make gifts of gold are said to make gifts of every thing in the world.

sa: सर्वथा यत्पशून् पाति तैश्च यद् रमते सह। तेषामधिपतिर्यच्च तस्मात् पशुपतिः स्मृतः॥
en: Because he always nourishes all crcatures and sports also with them, and because he is their lord or master, therefore is he called Pashupati (the lord of all creatures).

sa: मम बाहुसहस्रं तु पश्यतां सैनिका रणे। विक्रमेण महीं कृत्स्ना जयेयं संशितव्रत॥
en: Indeed, let combatants, when fighting, see me possessed of a thousand arms. Observant also of high vows, let me succeed in subjugating the entire Earth by my prowess. son

sa: भगवांश्चापि सम्प्रीतो वह्निर्भवति नित्यशः। न तं त्यजन्ति पशवः संग्रामे च जयत्यपि॥
en: The illustrious god of fire becomes pleased with such a man. As another reward, he never becomes divested of cattle, and he is sure to win victory in battle.

sa: कृशाय कृतविद्याय वृत्तिक्षीणाय सीदते। अपहन्यात् क्षुधां यस्तु न तेन पुरुषः समः॥
en: No man is equal to him who satisfies the hunger of a person who is emaciated, possessed of learning, destitute of the means of support, and weakened by misery.

sa: स्थिरलिङ्गश्च यन्नित्यं तस्मात् स्थाणुरिति स्मृतः। यदस्य बहुधा रूपं भूतं भव्यं भवत्तथा॥
en: His emblem, again, is fixed and immovable for all time. He is, for these reasons, called Sthanu. He is also of multiform aspect. He is present, past, and future.

sa: भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं च पतितं भुवि। चित्राड्दा परित्रस्ता प्रविवेश रणाजिरे॥
en: Hearing that her husband had been killed and that her son had fallen down on the Earth, Chitrangada, in great agitation of mind, went to the field of battle.

sa: षष्ठे काले सदा विप्रो भुडन्तै तैः सह सुव्रतः। षष्ठे काले कदाचित् तु तस्याहारो न विद्यते॥ भुक्तेऽन्यस्मिन् कदाचित् स षष्ठे काले द्विजोत्तमः। कदाचिद् धर्मिणस्तस्य दुर्भिक्षे सति दारुणे॥ नाविद्यत तदा विप्राः संचयस्तन्निबोधता क्षीणौषधिसमावेशे द्रव्यहीनोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: Of excellent vows, he used to cat every day at the sixth division. If there was nothing to eat at the sixth division of the day, that excellent Brahmana would fast for that day and eat the next day at the sixth division. On one occasion, you Brahmanas, there took place a dreadful famine in the land. During that time there was nothing stored in the abode of that righteous Brahmana. The herbs and plants were all dried up and the whole kingdom became void of food-stores.

sa: अन्नदानं प्रधानं हि कौन्तेय परिचक्षते। अन्नस्य हि प्रदानेन रन्तिदेवो दिवं गतः॥
en: The gift of food, O son of Kunti, is considered as a very superior gift. Formerly king Rantideva ascended to the celestial region by having made gifts of food.

sa: प्राणदानाद्धि परमं न दानमिह विद्यते। श्रुतं हि ते महाबाहो लोमशस्यापि तद्वचः॥
en: There is no gift in this world which is superior to the gift of life. You are not unacquainted with this saying of Lomasha, O you of mighty arms.

sa: अमरं याज्यमासाद्य याजयिष्ये न मानुषम्। शक्रेण प्रतिषिद्धोऽहं मरुत्तं मा स्म याजयः॥ स्पर्धते हि मया विप्र सदा हि स तु पार्थिवः। एवमस्त्विति चाप्युक्तो भ्रात्रा ते बलसूदनः॥
en: He said, Having secured the priest-hood of the Immortals, I do not wish to act for the mortals, and, I have been forbidden by Shakra (Indra) to officiate at Marutta's sacrifice, as he told me that Marutta having become king, was always filled with a desire to rival him. And to this your brother agreed by saying to the destroyer of Vala (Indra), Be it so.

sa: श्रोत्रमुवाच नेमे बाणास्तरिष्यन्ति मामलर्क कथंचन। तवैव मर्म भेत्स्यन्ति ततो हास्यसि जीवितम्॥
en: The car said These arrows will not, O Alarka pass though ine. They will pierce your own vital parts only, and your vital parts being pierced, you shall die.

sa: अधीत्यापि हि यो वेदान् न्यायविद्ध्यः प्रयच्छति।।१९ गुरुकर्मप्रशंसी तु सोऽपि स्वर्गे महीयते।
en: That man who having himself read the Vedas, imparts a knowledge thereof to righteous disciples, and who praises the acts of his own preceptor, acquires great honors in Heaven.

sa: बृहस्पति उवाच सुवर्णदानं गोदानं भूमिदानं च वृत्रहन्। दददेतान् महाप्राज्ञः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Brihaspati said Gift of gold, gift of kine, and gift of earth, by these, O destroyer of Vritra, one becomes cleansed, O you of great wisdom, of all sins.

sa: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा ये चाश्रितास्तपः। दानधर्माग्निना शुद्धास्ते स्वर्ग यान्ति भारत॥
en: Those amongst Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras, who perforin penances, O Bharata, and who purify themselves, by gifts and other deeds of righteousness, proceed to the celestial region.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच विजितेयं धरा कृत्स्रा सव्यसाचिन् परंतप। त्वद्वाहुबलमाश्रित्य राज्ञा धर्मसुतेन ह॥
en: Vasudeva said O Arjuna, the terror of your enemies, this cntire earth has been conquered by the king, the son of Dharma, depending on the power of your arms.

sa: सा त्वां प्रसाद्य शिरसा याचे शत्रुनिबर्हणम्। प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि गोविन्द नायं संजीवते यदि॥
en: That self-same mother now seeks to please you, O slayer of enemies, by bending her head! Surely, O Govinda, I shall kill myself if this child does not revive.

sa: सत्येन देवाः प्रीयन्ते पितरो ब्राह्मणास्तथा। सत्यमाहुः परो धर्मस्तस्मात् सत्यं न लड्वयेत्॥
en: It is Truth that pleases the deities, the departed Manes, and the Brahmanas, Truth has been said to be the highest duty. Therefore, no one should ever transgress Truth.

sa: मनसापि गुरोर्भार्यां यः शिष्यो याति पापकृत्। स उग्रान् प्रैति संसारानधर्मेणेह चेतसा॥
en: That sinful disciple who even in thought knows the wife of his preceptor, has, on account of such a sinful heart, to undergo many dreadful shapes in this world.

sa: एतद् विप्रा विजानीत हन्त भूयो ब्रवीमि वः॥ सहस्रेणापि दुर्मेधा न बुद्धिमधिगच्छति।
en: Understand this, you learned Brahmanas! Well, I shall now tell you something more. With even a thousand (explanations), one who has a bad understanding succeeds not in acquiring knowledge.

sa: यथा जनित्री स्वं पुत्रं क्षीरेण भरते सदा। अनुगृह्णाति दातारं तथा सर्वरसैर्मही॥
en: As the mother always nourishes her own child with milk from her breast, so does earth please with all the tastes the person that makes a gift of earth.

sa: वयोनौ तु स सम्भूतस्त्रीणि वर्षाणि जीवति। तत्रापि निधनं प्राप्तः कृमियोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: First taking birth in the canine order he has to live for three years. Throwing off the canine forin when death comes, he is born as a vile vermin.

sa: ताभ्यो वरं ददौ ब्रह्मा तपसोऽन्ते स्वयं प्रभुः। एवं भवत्विति प्रभुर्लोकांस्तारयतेति च॥
en: Appearing to them at the termination of their austerities, the powerful Brahman gave them the boons they sought, sayingyour desire will be fulfilled. Do you rescue all the worlds.

sa: शिलवृत्तिरुवाच के देशाः के जनपदाः केऽऽश्रमाः के च पर्वताः। प्रकृष्टाः पुण्यतः काश्च ज्ञेया नद्यस्तुदुच्यत्ताम्॥
en: The Poor Brahmana said What are those countries, what are those provinces, what those hermitages, what those mountains, and what those rivers that should be considered as the foremost in sanctity? Do you describe this to me.
